title: Law to shift pedicab oversight to the Taxi Commission
summary: This bill would move licensing and regulation of pedicabs from the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to the Taxi and Limousine Commission (TLC), which would issue licenses to pedicab businesses and drivers and enforce pedicab rules. TLC would also study and report on ways to lower insurance costs for pedicab businesses and drivers. The law would take effect 180 days after being signed.
